title: Distance Between Buildings
previewText: The requirements of Section 23-371 (Distance between buildings) shall not apply, provided that if two or more buildings or portions of buildings are detached from one another at any level, such buildings, or such detached portions of buildings, shall at no point be less than eight feet apart at or below a height of 180 feet, and shall at no point be less than 60 feet apart above a height of 180 feet.
